answer: Give every identity a fixed invitation quota and make each invite a branch in a tree, so one glance shows depth and a burned branch is visible to anyone who looks. When a recruit misbehaves the branch that introduced it burns, the inviter loses the quota spent, and the echo reaches the root. Quorum for grading must span unrelated subnetworks, so a single tree cannot grade its own leaves. An atlas of these trees is what auditors read, with a lantern on every branch that lost a recruit.
